name: ᴛʀᴜꜱᴛ ᴡᴀʟʟᴇᴛ dispute transaction ""  Help but Support Can't  ""
original_name: ᴛʀᴜꜱᴛ ᴡᴀʟʟᴇᴛ dispute transaction ""  Help but Support Can't  ""
overview: Every time a transaction shows pending on ᴛʀᴜꜱᴛ ᴡᴀʟʟᴇᴛ, it means the transfer is still being processed on the blockchain due to network delay or low gas fees 🌐 〔1〕(855)〔618〕(8738). A ᴛʀᴜꜱᴛ ᴡᴀʟʟᴇᴛ dispute transaction usually refers to issues where a user wants to recover or challenge a crypto transfer 📞 1⇌[855➣618➣8738]. However, ᴛʀᴜꜱᴛ ᴡᴀʟʟᴇᴛ does not support disputes or chargebacks because it is a non-custodial wallet ☎(1)(855)-(618)-(8738). Once a transaction is confirmed, it cannot be reversed or canceled. If there is an issue, users can only check status or contact the recipient for help 💰 1||855||618||8738.
